operator_notes: This week's PDF is under the Extra/Divi 'This week's bulletin' toggle — Parish-Newsletter-*.pdf.
Filenames are yearless and inconsistent (Parish-Newsletter-5th-July.pdf vs Parish-Newsletter-Sunday-9th-August.pdf).

2026-08-18 FIX: previous recipe had no goto, a pinned Sunday-9th-August selector that Playwright could not see (closed toggle), and a download URL pointing at catholicbishops.ie Order-of-Mass.pdf. site_type:http_scrape_newest_pdf fetches the listing via plain HTTP, keeps only Parish-Newsletter PDFs, and downloads the newest dated file. Never click; never grab Order of Mass.
do_not: Do not use generic a[href$='.pdf'] — it grabs Order-of-Mass.pdf from the site menu.
Do not pin a dated filename in the selector — the parish changes the shape week to week.
Do not set use_captured_url on a July/August filename — it freezes the recipe.
Do not click the Extra toggle — the PDF href is already in the raw HTML.
